<response>The possibility of parasites from garbage surviving in humans for weeks depends on the specific parasite and environmental conditions. In the meantime, practice good hygiene (e.g., washing hands thoroughly after handling waste, avoiding direct skin contact) to minimize exposure risks.</response>
